our_title: kgraphMapFm keeps a stale domain array pointer after its fallback reallocates it
ran: $WORK/repro/PS3-G13-1/vardom.c (gra02int on vcmplt). With 7.0.17's GRA-02 fix rebased alone: `./vardom 40 0 2` -> 'AddressSanitizer: heap-use-after-free READ ... #0 _SCOTCHarchVcmpltDomDist arch_vcmplt.c:155 #1 _SCOTCHkgraphMapFm kgraph_map_fm.c:1814', 'freed by thread T3 ... realloc ... _SCOTCHmapResize mapping.c:180 ... kgraphMapRbPart3 kgraph_map_rb_part.c:119'. Pristine 7.0.18 dies earlier on GRA-02 (kgraph_map_fm.c:129). Series (0006 also re-reads domntab): 'after: ret=0 domnnbr=1600 fronnbr=1600' and 64 0 2 -> domnnbr=4096, 32/64-bit.
read_only: Public-API trigger not constructed: needs a frontier-less imbalanced mapping reaching kgraphMapFm on a variable-sized target with more than min(1023, vertnbr)+1 resulting domains.
location_7_0_18: src/libscotch/kgraph_map_fm.c:1006 (`const ArchDom * restrict const  domntab = grafptr->m.domntab;`), fallback at :1048; src/libscotch/kgraph_map_rb_part.c:119 (mapResize); src/libscotch/mapping.c:105-108 (mapInit: domnmax = MIN (1023, vertnbr) + 1 for variable-sized targets)
evidence: kgraph_map_fm.c:1006 caches domntab before :1048 `kgraphMapSt (grafptr, strat);`; kgraph_map_rb_part.c:119 `if ((o = mapResize (mappptr, domnnum + (domnnum >> 2) + 8)) != 0)` reallocates mappptr->domntab.

fix_options.label: Re-read domntab with domnnbr after the fallback (folded into the GRA-02 commit)
fix_options.summary: domntab becomes a non-const local set at entry and after the fallback.
fix_options.tested: vardom 40 0 2 / 64 0 2 / 16 4 1 pass 32/64; GRA-02 kits pass; check_scotch_graph_map/gmap/gpart pass.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Same fix as the count, same place.

our_title: kgraphMapFm error paths leak the imbalance, save and extended edge arrays
read_only: kgraph_map_fm.c:1096-1098 (out of memory (4): nothing freed but the table), :1107-1110 and :1483-1486 ('memFree (vexxtab); /* Free group leader */' although vexxtab, savetab and edxxtab are three separate memAlloc's, :1093-1095), :1475-1478 (out of memory (6) frees savetab only): comploadmax, savetab, edxxtab (and chektab under SCOTCH_DEBUG_KGRAPH3) leak; the normal exit frees all of them at :1843-1849.
why_not_run: Allocation-failure paths; not injected this round (no plain build). Pre-existing, not introduced by 7.0.18; our GRA-17 remainder follows the same convention.
evidence: kgraph_map_fm.c:1107-1110 `errorPrint ("kgraphMapFm: out of memory (5)"); memFree    (vexxtab);                       /* Free group leader */ kgraphMapFmTablExit (tablptr); return (1);`
